text:
Priya (AE): kicking off NewtonBridge POC. Theyre replacing BlueHub and want drop-in compatibility for two endpoints + minimal prompt changes. Main asks: parity on stop tokens, consistent token billing, and answers for security questionnaire.
Luca (SE): got it. Is the ask purely API surface parity or also response deltas (formatting / whitespace)?
Priya (AE): both. They saw formatting diffs (leading/trailing spaces) and different truncated responses when stop tokens were used.
Ravi (Infra): what load profile should we reserve? dev pool sizing depends on concurrency and streaming needs.
Priya (AE): baseline: 3 rps sustained, bursts to 20 rps, ~15 concurrent streams, EU region. They may run heavy batch evals later.
Hannah (Security): from the SQ POV: they want SOC2 report, list of subprocessors, data residency options, KMS support (bring-your-own-key), audit log retention, and IP allowlist. Also ask about short-lived credentials and mTLS.
Maya (Sales Ops): pricing: do we offer POC credits and what are dev rates?
Maya (Sales Ops): standard POC: first 150k tokens complimentary. Post-POC dev rate: generation $0.0028/token, embeddings $0.00035/embed. We can expand credits to 300k with approval.
Priya (AE): ask from buyer: can POC spend convert to committed reserved capacity? what's the conversion math?
Maya (Sales Ops): we can convert unused POC credits to prepaid commitment at MSRP minus 12% with a 6-month min commitment. I'll prepare term sheet.
Luca (SE): for compatibility plan I propose: 1) protocol shim that rewrites BlueHub fields to our schema, 2) post-processer to emulate BlueHub stop semantics, 3) tokenization parity pass and report. Example shim mapping snippet: 
```json
{"bh_input":"user_text","rw_prompt":"system: {{system}}\nuser: {{user_text}}","response_field":"text"}
```
Luca (SE): note: BlueHub applies stop matching on raw Unicode substrings; we should run both pre- and post-generation comparisons to match their behavior exactly.
Ravi (Infra): network/security: we can provide egress CIDRs, support mTLS for POC endpoint, and issue time-bound API keys (24h). For hosted POC we can enable envelope encryption; for strict KMS BYOK we need Private deployment.
Hannah (Security): please add vendor subprocessors list for hosted POC and a quick SOC2 summary doc. I'll attach standard SQ answer template.
Luca (SE): sample compatibility call for engineering: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://compat.redwood-internal/api/v1/bluehub/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"bluehub-lite","input":"{{input}}","max_tokens":200}'
```
Luca (SE): shim will surface BlueHub-like fields: `generated_text`, `usage.tokens.total` and `compat_mode:true`. We'll also return `compat.token_delta` for their audit.
Priya (AE): they reported ~18% token difference in their sampling. Can SE run tokenization parity and give a delta report across 12 representative prompts?
Luca (SE): yes. I'll run tokenization and return counts + normalized outputs. Recommend we also surface tokenization score per prompt.
Maya (Sales Ops): logistics: if they want >150k credits now, we can invoice optional 300k POC bundle. Are we ok to create a one-off invoice?
Priya (AE): yes, please prepare invoice. buyer prefers net-30.
Maya (Sales Ops): will confirm with finance.
DeployBot: queued deployment to dev-pool-newtonbridge at 2024-11-06T09:30:00Z (sha: d4e5f6).
Ravi (Infra): ops note: adding experiment header `x-rw-expt` for correlation, will include in logs and deliver a mapping file to them. Also adding fallback routing: if semantic similarity (cosine) between our output embedding and their baseline < 0.9, route to high-precision variant for that request.
Hannah (Security): require subprocessor list and data flow diagram for hosted POC. I'll draft the answers and post in thread. Also confirm audit log retention: 90 days by default for POC; can extend with enterprise add-on.
Luca (SE): also adding a side-by-side A/B mode: we can run their BlueHub baseline in parallel on a small sample and compute difference metrics (token delta, BLEU-ish formatting diffs, stop-handling divergence) and produce a report.
Priya (AE): excellent. Action items: Luca -> push tokenization parity script + sample shim example; Ravi -> publish CIDRs + mTLS cert plan + experiment header; Hannah -> initial SQ responses + subprocessors list + SOC2 pointer; Maya -> draft invoice/term sheet for 300k option and conversion terms. I'll schedule follow-up tomorrow 11:00 CET with NewtonBridge.
Maya (Sales Ops): noted, will send proforma and payment link if they opt for 300k.
Priya (AE): thanks team, I'll update NewtonBridge and upload buyer SQ when it arrives. Closing thread for now :rocket:
__comment: Realistic presales Slack thread for NewtonBridge POC migrating from BlueHub competitor. Single continuous string, messages prefixed by sender names, matches agents.md schema.
